start.title: Three Graves in Moab
start.text:
Naomi has lost her husband and sons.
Grief settles like dusk.

choices.text: Sit in silence beside her grief
choices.feedback: Ruth 1:3-5 — Naomi's husband Elimelech died, and then her two sons, Mahlon and Chilion, also died.

choices.text: Leave her to mourn alone
Tell her to forget the dead

alone_consequence.title: Return to Her
alone_consequence.text:
She is your mother by love.
Go back and sit with her.

choices.text: Sit in silence beside her grief
choices.feedback: She leans her head to yours.

forget_consequence.title: Honor Her Loss
forget_consequence.text:
Grief is not a stain to wipe.
Let her weep beside you.

choices.text: Sit in silence beside her grief
choices.feedback: You bow your head with hers.

road_decision.title: She Tells You to Go Home
road_decision.text:
"Return to your people," she pleads.
The road forks before you.

choices.text: Turn back to Moab and your gods
Wait for another to decide for you
"Where you go, I will go."
choices.feedback: Ruth 1:16 — Ruth told Naomi, "Where you go, I will go, and where you stay, I will stay. Your people will be my people and your God my God."

turnback_consequence.title: Loyalty Calls You
turnback_consequence.text:
Comfort lies behind, but love walks ahead.
Go with Naomi.

choices.text: "Where you go, I will go."

wait_consequence.title: Choose for Yourself
wait_consequence.text:
No one can carry your vow but you.
Speak it now.

choices.text: "Where you go, I will go."
choices.feedback: The words rise from your heart.

bethlehem_arrival.title: Bethlehem at Dawn
bethlehem_arrival.text:
Naomi returns home empty-handed.
The village whispers around you.

choices.text: Hide your Moabite roots in shame
Beg in the street for bread
Offer to glean grain to feed her
choices.feedback: Ruth 2:2 — Ruth asked Naomi if she could go to the fields and glean among the ears of grain behind anyone in whose eyes she might find favor.

hide_consequence.title: Walk Without Shame
hide_consequence.text:
Your love for Naomi is not a stain.
Lift your head and serve.

choices.text: Offer to glean grain to feed her

beg_consequence.title: Take Up the Sickle
beg_consequence.text:
Your hands can gather what falls.
The fields are open to the poor.

choices.text: Offer to glean grain to feed her

barley_field.title: Among the Reapers
barley_field.text:
Boaz, kind and strong, sees you working.
"Stay in my fields," he says.

choices.text: Refuse his kindness in pride
choices.feedback: Grace is meant to be received.

choices.text: Bow and thank him with humility
choices.feedback: Ruth 2:10 — Ruth bowed down with her face to the ground and asked Boaz why she had found such favor in his eyes.

choices.text: Demand more than he offers

refuse_consequence.title: Receive His Kindness
refuse_consequence.text:
Pride leaves you with empty hands.
Accept the gift before you.

choices.text: Bow and thank him with humility

demand_consequence.title: A Quiet Heart
demand_consequence.text:
His mercy is not yours to seize.
Receive it gently.

choices.text: Bow and thank him with humility

threshing_floor.title: Naomi's Counsel
threshing_floor.text:
"Go to the threshing floor," she says.
"Ask Boaz to be your redeemer."

choices.text: Trust Naomi and go in faith
choices.feedback: Ruth 3:5 — Ruth told Naomi, "I will do everything you say."

choices.text: Ignore her wisdom and stay home
Seek a wealthier man instead
choices.feedback: Boaz is the kinsman God gave.

ignore_consequence.title: Walk in Faith
ignore_consequence.text:
Naomi's counsel is your map.
Follow it through the dark.

choices.text: Trust Naomi and go in faith

seek_consequence.title: Honor the Redeemer
seek_consequence.text:
Wealth without kindness is barren.
Boaz is the heart God chose.

choices.text: Trust Naomi and go in faith

redemption_home.title: A New Family Line
redemption_home.text:
Boaz redeems you. A son is born.
Naomi smiles again at last.
